prompts.nezha:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a NEW production-ready 2D game sprite atlas, NOT a painted background. The supplied image is COSTUME/IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY: replace its anatomy and leaning idle pose. Nezha, handsome youthful Chinese male warrior, black hair in two SMALL buns, red silk ribbons, ivory sleeveless tunic, fitted red and gold light armor, slim waist, long legs, red boots, gold-and-red fire-tip spear. Warm hand-painted Japanese anime fantasy, crisp clean silhouette, refined young-adult heroic anatomy. CRITICAL: NO chibi, no big head, no short legs. Bare skull-to-chin height approximately 1/7.5 of standing body height, small natural face, shoulders about 2 head widths, legs 51% of height. Small hair buns must not enlarge the head silhouette. Full-body every frame.
Atlas 1024x1536 pixels, precisely FOUR columns and SIX rows, 24 separate square 256x256 frame cells. No labels, grid lines, borders, shadow, ground, backdrop, haze or glow. Genuine alpha-zero transparency between every sprite. Every frame stays inside its own cell with >=18px transparent margin ALL FOUR EDGES, including spear tip and trailing ribbons. No sprite touching another. Standing figure crown around local y=32 and soles local y=232, body about 200 pixels tall INCLUDING hair. Feet center local x=128. Keep same body and head scale in EVERY frame, never independently enlarge crouches or fallen frames. Spear is compact enough to fit: whole blade and butt fully inside local x=18..238.
All frames face RIGHT in a consistent three-quarter side battle view; orthographic level camera, no tilted image, no diagonal camera, no perspective shrinking. ROW 1 standing idle: almost identical 4-frame subtle breathing, spine VERTICAL, skull center / chest / pelvis all on local x=128, shoulders level, hips level, legs straight but relaxed, weight evenly planted, no crouching or leaning. This MUST read as a tall upright person. Spear held in one hand diagonally downward across body without changing spine. ROW2 four distinct run-cycle phases. ROW3 attack ready, anticipation, forward spear thrust/contact, return. ROW4 light hit recoil, recoil peak, straighten, return to upright. ROW5 defeat: stagger, kneel, fall, lying on ground. ROW6 skill: ready, raise gold ring, forward cast, return. Dynamic action may lean only during movement or attack, not idle. Anchor lowest boot/contact point to local y=232 on all rows. No large effects, separated VFX added by engine. Preserve red-white-gold costume identity but redraw with tall natural anatomy and smaller head.

CRITICAL standing pose: upright neutral strong posture, NOT leaning back or forward, NO tilted picture, no squat, no chibi. 8-head anatomy, head small, shoulders about 2.2 heads wide, lean torso and long legs. Keep full body, boots, cape and entire weapons visible.
Exact atlas layout 1024x1536, FOUR equal columns and SIX equal rows, square 256x256 cells,24 frames. Real transparent background, alpha zero everywhere except body/weapons. Feetcentrex128. Same physical head and body scale in ALL frames, crouched/dead frames stay smaller height. Every weapon and cape fitlocalx18..238/localy18..238. No row crossings.
Consistent LEFT-facing three-quarter side view in all frames, orthographic level camera. Row1 four subtle idle breaths: skull center, sternum and pelvis aligned vertically at x128, level shoulders/hips, straight relaxed legs, balanced stance, one baton held close vertical and other downward. Row2 four actual running steps left. Row3 prepare/anticipate/strike left/recover. Row4 light hit recoil/peak/straighten/return. Row5 stagger/kneel/fall/lie.
